rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a single image, but it is somewhat noncommittal about hatching despite the image/lab grade indicating herniation and gives only moderate detail on ICM/TE.
Integrates age, AMH/low oocyte yield, PCOS, endometrium, semen parameters, BMI, and lifestyle into prognosis well, though the discussion of PCOS with low reserve is a bit oversimplified.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, with conclusions matching the presented factors; minor issues include slight ambiguity around fresh vs frozen transfer and a questionable statement about PCOS response patterns.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, avoidance of routine add-ons, and individualized PGT-A discussion. Minor deviations include speculative donor-oocyte discussion at this stage.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, routine support, and reserve-aware family planning; useful but not highly tailored to protocol-specific decisions.
